name: fuzz-fleet-reminder-blocks-end-turn
description: Fuzz pbd385 / pbd386 (bot 1da6c62, invariant:fleet.supply): Xxcha placed a flagship in Warfare's home build (4 ships, fleet pool 3) and Crimson gave up a fleet token with 3 ships at home; the fleet-pool reminder (units.remove) was posted but nothing held the player to it, and the turn went on with the excess ships. Fix (bot fuzz-triage-2): units.remove options carry value.reminder; turn.action End Turn / Pass is refused while the player's reminder for a system still over its limits is open (its Dismiss sets it aside, as in the original); the web greys those buttons with the reason. Base: pinned pbd385 saves 141 (+142: Xxcha's End Turn prompt; 4 ships at 313, fleet pool 3, the reminder dismissed); one more destroyer added there posts the reminder again.
